text:
liz_k: Postmortem posted for the 03/18 multi-dep outage (cloud network + auth provider + registry auth lapse). Link: https://redwood-internal/pm/198200. Need to lock owners and dates for the vendor-side mitigations and infra robustness tasks.

ben_o: reading now. High level: two separate network flaps during a deploy, auth provider delayed token issuance, and model-registry returned stale tokens causing 401 floods. Seems like three failure modes that cascaded.

nina_ops: propose splitting into short-term ops actions and longer-term vendor/legal asks. Short-term: circuit-breakers, improved backoff, rolling deploy gating. Longer-term: SLA, cross-region fallback, vendor rotation playbook.

liz_k: suggested immediate owners/dates 
- circuit-breaker + deploy gate (eng-infra): owner ben_o -> due 2026-04-02
- token-refresh defensive measures in registry client (eng-platform): owner nina_ops -> due 2026-04-06
- vendor SLA and backup provider onboarding (security/vendor-eng): owner joel_s -> due 2026-04-20

ops-bot: Snapshot of affected services taken at 1982001300, logs archived to gs://redwood-incident-archives/198200.

ben_o: infra plan notes:
- implement deploy window detection to pause non-critical control-plane retries during rolling updates
- expose auth_refresh_latency and registry_stale_token_rate metrics
- add a malformed-token detector to avoid retry storms

nina_ops: for the registry client fix: add jittered staggered retries and a fallback cache read path that serves last-known-good until token refresh completes (with a metric). I'll open a PR with a unit/integration test that simulates 401 on refresh. Targeting staging by 1982001600.

liz_k: for recurring pattern detection, can we create an alert that looks for deploy-correlated auth_refresh_failures? Ben, can you own that alert spec? Target date 2026-03-30.

ben_o: will do. Alert spec will include: deploy-tag correlation, >10 auth_refresh_failures in 5m, and simultaneous network retransmit spikes.

joel_s: on vendor side: legal is already looped. I'll push for 15m incident notifications and a 99.95% token issuance SLA. Also starting quick onboarding docs for a secondary provider so we can failover within 1 hour if SLA missed.

liz_k: please add all tasks to the action tracker: https://redwood-internal/actions/198200. I'll run a 15min sync in the incidents channel tomorrow to confirm timelines.

nina_ops: one tiny follow-up: add a weekly canary that rotates tokens end-to-end and verifies no client 401s for a 10m window. I'll add the job to canary-configs and link the run to the action item.

ben_o: noted. I'll also add an ops dashboard tile for the newly published metrics.

liz_k: wrap-up: owners assigned (ben_o, nina_ops, joel_s), dates set, tests + runbooks, vendor SLA ask, and an alert to detect recurrence. Ping here if dates shift. :thumbsup:
